title: Replay of the buffered word
statement: Let $first,second$ be Boolean flags, let $x,a$ be Boolean words, and let $i\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $i\le |x|$. From the pair extractor's replay state at input position $i$, with buffer $a$, work head at zero, and empty output, after any $j\le |a|$ steps the machine is still in the replay state, its work head is at $j$, and its output is the first $j$ symbols of $a$ if $first$ is true and is empty otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: first and second are Boolean flags
x and a are Boolean words
replaced:
From the extractor's replay state with buffer $a$ and work head at
displacement $0$, for any $j \le \abs{a}$, exactly $j$ steps move the work
head to displacement $j$ and emit the first $j$ bits of $a$ when the
first-component flag is set, and nothing otherwise.
